label: Diagram 3.8
caption: Diagram 3.8 Horizontal escape for flats served by more than one common stair
description:
Diagram 3.8, "Horizontal escape for flats served by more than one common stair", comprises three horizontal plan views. At top: "See paras 3.27 and 3.40".

a. "Corridor access without dead ends": a long shaded grey corridor runs horizontally, lined above and below by squares labelled F, with hatched stair blocks at each end. A door marked Fd sits mid-corridor; a dimension line below reads "30m max."

b. "Corridor access with dead ends", subtitled "The central door may be omitted if maximum travel distance is not more than 15m": a similar corridor with F squares both sides, hatched stair blocks left and right, three doors marked Fd, and dimensions "7.5m max.", "30m max.", "7.5m max."

c. "'T' junction with main corridor": a T-shaped corridor with F squares around it, two doors marked Fd, a "7.5m max." dimension, and green escape-route arrows.

Right-hand key: Fd Cross-corridor fire doorset; F Flat; a shaded box for ventilation zones per paras 3.54–3.57; green line = Fire resisting construction; arrow = Escape route. Two NOTES follow.

notes: The description quotes the top text as "See paras 3.27 and 3.40", but the drawing reads "See para 3.27 and 3.40" (singular).

For view b the description says "hatched stair blocks left and right", but the drawing shows the hatched stair blocks inset within the rows (one upper, one lower), with F squares occupying the left and right ends.
